nodes.name: leave/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Leave management page: displays leave balance, request form (type, dates, reason), approval workflow visualization, leave history table with status filters, and calendar view. Uses leaveService for API calls and LeaveForm component for validation.

nodes.name: overtime/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Overtime management page: overtime request form (date, hours, reason, attachment), pre-approval workflow, overtime balance tracker, history with filter by month/status, and export to Excel. Integrates with overtimeService and WorkShift context.

nodes.name: overview/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Attendance dashboard overview: real-time status (checked in/out), today's schedule, leave balance summary, overtime hours this month, late/early stats, and quick actions (check-in, request leave, request OT). Uses AttendanceOverviewTab component.

nodes.name: schedule/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Work schedule page: weekly/monthly calendar view, shift assignments with color coding, swap request workflow, shift template management, and conflict detection. Uses WorkShiftTab and ScheduleCalendar components.

nodes.name: chat/page.tsx
nodes.summary: AI Chat interface: conversation list sidebar, message thread with streaming responses, citation display, document preview modal, suggested prompts, conversation history, and model selector. Integrates with aiService for streaming chat and document retrieval.

nodes.name: dashboard/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Main dashboard: KPI cards (headcount, pending requests, upcoming birthdays, expiring contracts), recent activity feed, quick action shortcuts, and personalized widgets based on user role. Server component with Suspense boundaries.

nodes.name: employees/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Employee directory: searchable table with filters (department, status, role), pagination, column sorting, bulk actions, export CSV, and detail drawer with tabs (profile, contract, salary, attendance, assets). Uses employeeService and EmployeeTable component.

nodes.name: assets/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Asset management: asset catalog with categories, assignment tracking, request workflow (create, approve, assign, return), maintenance scheduling, and depreciation reports. Integrates with assetService and AssetRequestModal.

nodes.name: it-tickets/page.tsx
nodes.summary: IT Ticket system: ticket list with status/priority filters, create ticket form (category, description, attachment, SLA), assignment workflow, comment thread, resolution tracking, and SLA dashboard. Uses ticketService and TicketDetailModal.

nodes.name: performance-reviews/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Performance review hub: cycle management, self-assessment form, manager review workflow, calibration session, score distribution analytics, and export. Tabs: overview, history, management. Uses performanceService.
